title: Create tuner.py — skill-aware weight adjustment for prefetch
acceptance_criteria: tune_weights(base_weights, skill_graph, task_categories) → dict: adjusted weights based on proficiency
Novice in category → widen relevance (lower threshold, boost category weight)
Expert in category → tighten relevance (higher threshold, boost confidence weight)
Uses AgentSkillGraph.get_skills() pattern for proficiency lookup
Returns dict with same keys as DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, values adjusted ±0.2 max
